howIntro: Find paths to explore the Bible, study the world in dialogue with Christian faith and turn learning into care. Read, listen, watch, ask questions and take part in initiatives for the common good. Choose where to begin and continue at your own pace.
howSteps: Learn and study: read the Bible and explore faith, virtues, self-care and subjects such as philosophy, history and science.
Follow the content: find articles, studies, films, animation, music, playlists and gatherings in your preferred format.
Help and participate: offer time, knowledge, food, clothing or a partnership; discover the tools we aim to develop for the community.

author1: I am Marcos Lucas Pereira, creator of the Global Evangelization Platform in Nova Bandeirantes, Mato Grosso, Brazil. My purpose is to serve God and share Jesus’ teachings through the study of Scripture, reflection and content in accessible language.
author2: I want to bring faith and everyday life closer: learn, ask questions, teach clearly and turn knowledge into care for others. The platform brings together studies, articles, videos and proposed tools that may help schools, churches and the community.
author3: I believe in sharing what we learn and putting our abilities at the service of others. The project therefore also includes developing tools with AI assistance and building initiatives for solidarity, education and support for those most in need. This work will grow step by step through dialogue, responsibility and partnerships.
careHomeIntro: Food, rest, emotions and relationships deserve attention. Find reflections and educational guidance to recognize your limits, nurture respectful relationships and bring spiritual life into everyday care.
careHighlights: Body and routine: food, rest and achievable breaks.
Emotions and relationships: recognize feelings, talk and seek support.
Spiritual life: prayer, reflection on Scripture and care for others.
faithCenterIntro: God is at the centre of this journey. We begin from Christian faith to understand creation, seek meaning in what we study and turn knowledge into love and care. Science, mathematics, history, language, philosophy, arts and crafts are places for this search.
faithCenterPrinciple: Our guiding commitment is to look to God as the foundation for understanding all things. We study Scripture, investigate each discipline and develop reflections on creation, God’s existence and purpose. We identify the sources, arguments and interpretations we present, taking responsibility for what we teach.
faithCenterMethod: Each resource should unite study, faith and service: learn the subject, reflect on God as Creator and ask how this learning can serve life and others. Open questions are part of the search, with humility to study, listen and revise.
faithCenterScripture: Genesis presents creation as good; Colossians expresses Christ’s centrality in creation. These passages guide our Christian conviction to place God at the centre of knowledge and life. Reading Scripture accompanies the study and reflection of each discipline.
